# brand-template

larch is a fictional brand, written for petals' specs on 2026-11-11. Each file
is a template from `petals/templates/` filled in as the template directs, with
the token prefix `--larch-`. `tests/template-brand.spec.sh` holds that the
templates write the format petals' scripts read, for a brand whose prefix is
not plotplot's. The ratios in the Contrast Pairings table were measured with
the WCAG 2.x formula check.sh uses.
